On 2026-11-20 the user asked to "work on a1+ Unit 7 same all deal as before none stop all approved": the A1+ Unit 7 map (A1+ 7.Y follows A1 7.Y, one step each, fifteen lessons) approved up front, straight to Preview, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Four new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash): Ana with a birthday cake under spring blossom, Luis with his cake on a summer beach, Sofia with hers in a fall park, Diego with his by a window onto falling snow; the candles carry no numbers. A month is never told apart by a picture: a wrong month is always from another season, which the photo rules out.

lesson.title: 7.10 My birthday is in summer
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Say when something happens with in + a season or a month (My birthday is in summer. / It's in May.) and ask When is your birthday?.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.10 Seasons: A1 names the seasons (It is summer.); A1+ 7.10 says when things happen. The one new grammar relationship is in + a season or a month (My birthday is in summer. / It's in May. / It's cold in winter.); a whole date takes on (A1+ 4.13), a month or a season alone takes in. Four new photos give each cast member a birthday cake in their season, so the photo shows the season and the line names the month; A1 7.10's season photos and A1+ 1.3's swimmers bring back the weather and actions.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 7.10 the seasons; A1 4.13-4.14 the months and birthday; A1 7.4 hot, cold and windy; A1+ 3.11 name + 's.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Join in to the season (in-SUM-er, in-WIN-ter); say When is your birthday? with the stress on BIRTH. Do not require native-like speed.
